classify_evidences.text: The top genes were clustered to identify spatially coexpressed feature modules using clusterSpatialCorFeats function, with the following parameters set as follows: k = 17 and gene number of 3,000 for flower organs throughout all stages.

Seurat objects were first converted to Giotto objects, employing the seuratToGiotto function, and spatially coherent expression patterns were identified using the binSpect function, ith parameters as follows: bin_method = ‘rank’, calc_hub = T and hub_min_int = 5.
